title: Your company details
intro: We need these details to verify your company. Until then your account is pending: you can add listings and contacts, but not share or publish them.

fields.name: Company name
fields.taxIdHint: Company CIF (e.g. B12345674), or NIF/NIE for a self-employed agent.
fields.registerNumberHint: Your regional estate-agent register number where your region requires one (e.g. AICAT in Catalonia). It cannot change after verification.

saved: Saved. Our team will review your company shortly.

errors.taxIdFormat: This is not a Spanish CIF, NIF or NIE. Example: B12345674.
errors.taxIdControl: The last digit or letter does not match the number. Please check it for typos.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed these details meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
errors.forbidden: Only an administrator of your company can change these details.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.locked: Your company is verified: its name, tax id and register number can only change through our team.
